We've noticed severe lasting performance degradation of our raid
arrays when we have drives that yield large amounts of media errors.
The raid10 module will queue each failed read for retry
will attempt call fix_read_error() to perform the read recovery.
Read recovery is performed while the array is frozen
recovery attempts can degrade the performance of the array for
extended periods of time.
With this patch I propose adding a per md device max number of
corrected read attempts.  Each rdev will maintain a count of
read correction attempts in the rdev->read_errors field (not
used currently for raid10). When we enter fix_read_error()
we'll check to see when the last read error occurred
divide the read error count by 2 for every hour since the
last read error. If at that point our read error count
exceeds the read error threshold
In addition in this patch I add sysfs nodes (get/set) for
the per md max_read_errors attribute
